description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing address-related state in a React-Redux application, including fetching, adding, updating, and deleting addresses via API calls.

methods.name: addressChange
methods.description: Creates an action to update address form data with a new value for a given field.

methods.name: addressEditChange
methods.description: Creates an action to update address edit form data with a new value for a given field.

methods.name: handleAddressSelect
methods.description: Creates an action to select an address.

methods.name: setAddressLoading
methods.description: Creates an action to set the loading state for address operations.

methods.name: fetchAddresses
methods.description: Asynchronous thunk action to fetch all addresses from the API.

methods.name: fetchAddress
methods.description: Asynchronous thunk action to fetch a specific address by ID from the API.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Asynchronous thunk action to validate and add a new address via API, then update state and show notifications.

methods.name: updateAddress
methods.description: Asynchronous thunk action to validate and update an existing address via API, then update state and show notifications.

methods.name: deleteAddress
methods.description: Asynchronous thunk action to delete an address by ID via API, then update state and show notifications.
